items.q: I think I met the engineer, a really great guy, Toby.

ctx.x: You know and sometimes it’s fun and sometimes like where’s the beat. Plus playing tuba, it’s like a bass thing. So if it’s not in there, and I really had to hear what the bass player was doing. It was so easy. I’m in a recording studio, they sent a limo to my house in New York to go to South Jersey to Rumson where one of his houses was where he had a recording studio there. So they’re doing this stuff and I’m listening to all this music. They’re doing a little editing before I come in. And I’m like sitting there…

could be like oh I’m playing with so-and so, you know, like that. And so it took a while for him to get ready. They keep the limo there, they’re paying for the limo, and I’m talking about a really nice limo. “Would you like a drink or something?” Stuff like that. And so I’m listening to them do the music and they’re doing a little editing they had to finish, and it was all stuff I knew from playing in that jug band.
